title: Moss and the Big Mess
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added).

pages.text: The feeder is a big mess.
pages.illustration: A wooden bird table scattered untidily with spilled seed and bits of husk.
Scattered seed and husk bits lying in the grass beneath the bird table.
Moss the hedgehog holding a flat wood chip like a little scoop.

pages.text: Moss picks up bits with it.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog using the flat chip to scoop up scattered seed bits.
Moss the hedgehog setting down a small cloth bag beside the bird table.

pages.text: Moss fits bits in the bag.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog tipping scooped-up bits into the small bag.
Moss the hedgehog scooping up one more scattered bit from the grass.
The wooden bird table standing clean and tidy, all mess cleared away.
Moss the hedgehog standing back, grinning proudly at the tidy bird table.
